How this tracker works

One feed, month views, auto rollup — now with column drag, freeze, full-colour status, value sort, and a large detail drawer.
1
Schedule Pipeline is the feed. Reorder columns by dragging headers; freeze Job/Customer/Site; resize by dragging edges. Sorted by value, highest first.
2
Full details in a drawer. Double-click a row (or ⋮ → Open details) for a large panel with dates, owner, priority, risks and a big Notes box.
3
Status & month changes confirm first. Change a status or Planned Month and you’ll be asked “Move this job?” before it applies.
4
Value auto-sorts. Edit an amount (type $ and commas if you like) and the list reorders highest-first on save.
5
Undo anything with the toast or Ctrl+Z. Everything — layout included — auto-saves to this browser.
